title: Instruction-Conditioned Electromagnetic Spectrum Understanding via Budget-Adaptive Signal Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2610.12142v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electromagnetic spectrum monitoring increasingly requires flexible analysis beyond task-specific recognition and detection. Multimodal large language models offer a unified interface, but extending vision-language models (VLMs) to raw I/Q signals requires tokenization that balances fidelity against a strict budget. For signals, dense encoding causes token costs to grow with observation length, whereas fixed-resolution compression may discard short-duration or localized signal evidence. Thus, we propose \textbf{BATok}, a budget-adaptive signal tokenizer that adjusts token capacity to the input length while allocating that capacity according to the signal content. BATok constructs candidate representations from signal-derived features using lightweight multi-resolution branches, then combines a local energy prior with learnable queries to resample these representations into compact signal tokens. translated_title: 基于预算自适应信号词元化的指令条件电磁频谱理解
translated_abstract: 电磁频谱监测日益需要超越特定任务识别与检测的灵活分析能力。多模态大语言模型提供了一个统一的交互接口，但要将视觉-语言模型（VLM）扩展到原始I/Q信号，需要一种在保真度与严格预算之间取得平衡的词元化方法。对于信号而言，密集编码会导致词元成本随观测长度增长，而固定分辨率的压缩则可能丢失短时或局部化的信号证据。为此，我们提出了BATok——一种预算自适应的信号词元化器，它根据输入长度调整词元容量，并依据信号内容来分配该容量。BATok利用轻量级多分辨率分支从信号衍生特征构建候选表示，随后将局部能量先验与可学习查询相结合，将这些表示重采样为紧凑的信号词元。词元数量随输入长度自适应调整……
tldr: 提出预算自适应信号词元化器BATok，能够根据输入长度和信号内容动态调整词元容量与分配，使视觉-语言模型能够高效灵活地理解原始I/Q电磁频谱信号。
en_tdlr: We propose BATok, a budget-adaptive signal tokenizer that dynamically adjusts token capacity according to input length and signal content, enabling vision-language models to efficiently understand raw I/Q electromagnetic spectrum signals.
